candidate_patch.behavior: when two-part model@provider implies default but no literal default instance exists, use the provider's sole active instance; do not guess when multiple active instances exist

interpretation: Current RAGFlow main resolves the same two-part model reference differently between credential resolution and context-length resolution. The candidate patch restores sole-active-instance parity for context length without changing explicit three-part references.
limits: External probe targets the specific sole-active-instance case from issue #20140.
The patch has been validated by the targeted regression, not by RAGFlow's entire test suite.
No upstream PR has been opened because the current GitHub integration has read-only access to infiniflow/ragflow.
